symbols.name: LiteDbActiveEntityProvider
symbols.summary: Persists ActiveEntity records directly through a shared LiteDB database and scoped transaction session.
symbols.remarks: Use ActiveEntity APIs to run registered behaviors. This provider invokes supplied callbacks and owns persistence only. Dispose the DI scope asynchronously.

syntax.content: public sealed class LiteDbActiveEntityProvider : IActiveEntityEntityProvider where TEntity : class, IEntity

symbols.name: LiteDbActiveEntityProvider(LiteDbDatabaseSession, LiteDbActiveEntityProviderOptions, ILogger>)
symbols.summary: Creates an entity provider using an existing scoped database session and configured mappings.
symbols.remarks: Prefer UseLiteDbProvider for registration, mapping setup, and options snapshots. Manual composition must configure the database mapper before first use.
